entry.title: 【React Router】A Summary of useParams
entry.summary:
Introduction
Here's a quick summary of useParams. “A tool for easily extracting necessary information from URLs.” For example, consider this URL: /users/123
Here, the number “123” represents the “user ID”. That's where useParams comes in. const { id } = useParams();
Just writing this lets you extract parts of the URL, like: id = “123”
Product page /products/45 → Want to retrieve “Information for product number 45” Article page /articles/99 → Want to display “Content for article ID 99” User page /users/123 → Want to show “Profile for user 123” For pages like these, where the displayed content changes based on the URL, useParams becomes essential. useParams is a convenient mechanism that lets you use parts like :id or :name within a URL in your code.
